explanation: The agreement specifies delivery to the distribution center and an inspection process, but it does not state that the seller must install the units.
contract_text:
PURCHASE AGREEMENT

1. Parties. Alderbrook Packaging Ltd. (Seller) agrees to sell 18 automated carton-sealing units to Fenmere Distribution Ltd. (Buyer).

2. Price and Payment. The purchase price is USD 112,500. Buyer shall pay USD 37,500 upon signing and the balance within 15 days after delivery.

3. Delivery. Seller shall deliver the units to Buyer’s distribution center in Fairhaven within 40 calendar days after signing. Buyer shall provide reasonable access to the receiving area during normal business hours.

4. Inspection. Buyer may inspect the units within seven business days after delivery and shall notify Seller in writing of any visible damage or shortage found during that period.

5. Termination. Either party may terminate this Agreement for an uncured material breach by giving written notice and allowing 20 days for the breach to be cured.
claim_statement: The seller is required to install the units at the buyer’s distribution center.

evidence.clause_text: Seller warrants the equipment against defects in materials and workmanship for 12 months from the date of delivery.

explanation: Section 4 specifies a 12-month warranty from delivery, which contradicts the claim that the warranty lasts 24 months.
contract_text:
SALES AGREEMENT

1. Parties. Larkspur Thermal Systems Ltd. (Seller) will sell the equipment listed in the order schedule to Brackenridge Foods Ltd. (Buyer).

2. Price and Payment. The total purchase price is USD 76,200. Buyer shall pay the full amount within 30 days after receiving Seller’s invoice.

3. Delivery. Seller shall deliver the equipment to Buyer’s designated warehouse no later than 18 September 2026.

4. Warranty. Seller warrants the equipment against defects in materials and workmanship for 12 months from the date of delivery. Buyer must notify Seller in writing of a covered defect during the warranty period.

5. Termination. Buyer may terminate this Agreement if Seller fails to deliver within 20 days after receiving written notice of delay.
claim_statement: The agreement provides a 24-month warranty against defects in materials and workmanship.
The buyer must pay 30% of the total price within five business days after signing the agreement.

evidence.clause_text: Buyer shall pay 30% of the total price within five business days after signing this Agreement.

explanation: Section 3 expressly sets the initial payment at 30% of the total price and makes it due within five business days after signing.
contract_text:
PURCHASE AND SALES AGREEMENT

1. Parties. Cedar Vale Instruments Ltd. (Seller) agrees to sell the goods described in this Agreement to Rowan Field Laboratories Ltd. (Buyer).

2. Goods and Price. Seller shall supply 120 bench power modules at a total price of USD 48,600.

3. Payment. Buyer shall pay 30% of the total price within five business days after signing this Agreement. Buyer shall pay the remaining 70% within ten business days after delivery of all goods.

4. Delivery. Seller shall deliver all goods to Buyer’s receiving facility within 25 calendar days after receipt of the initial payment.

5. Warranty. Seller warrants that the goods will be free from defects in materials and workmanship for 12 months after delivery.

6. Termination. Either party may terminate this Agreement for a material breach if the breaching party fails to cure that breach within 15 days after receiving written notice.
